groups.reason: The remark about friends finding the south answers Adina's immediately preceding questions about southern travel and pineapples. Her reference note identifies Xavier's sister and her interest in faraway places; the marked rendering is less phonetically clear.
The complete marked phrase identifies the city watch, whose reference name and pronunciation are Praecanti Vigiles.
Delwath is choosing the story of the dragon slain on Circular Island; the dragon's reference note establishes Ra'ghemdros.
All three occurrences refer to Xavier and Adina's mother, explicitly named Francisca in her reference note.
These repeated variants identify the magical organization infiltrated by Fausto and connected to the chalyte trade; the reference note establishes Hetaeri Magica.
Both occurrences identify the Chardon market attacked by the planar incursion; the market reference establishes Kylos without a possessive ending.
Each occurrence names the volcanic mountain and fortified spur on the north bank of Chardon; the reference note establishes Nera.

All three occurrences identify the same naval flagship with Tiberius aboard; the ship reference and session narrative establish Auratan's Pride, despite older alternate spellings in the session's commented summary.
The party recalls its troublesome pirate double; the session record places that double in the Nevos Sea and the geographic note establishes the complete name.

The conversation concerns links from the Chardon session notes. North Bank is the detailed local geography page matching the immediately discussed area; North Lake is not an established matching page.
The speaker names the Drankorian organization associated with Apollyon while discussing the Cleansed's origins; the reference note establishes Omnis Pura.

Ordinary dialogue, numbers, mechanics, and damaged wording outside the name pass. Some spans contain recognizable names or titles inside longer unclear phrases; replacing them would require reconstruction rather than a complete name-only correction.

The party is aboard or discussing the location of its named skyship; the reference note establishes Vindristjarna.
The group is discussing converting its skyship to submarine travel. The unusual rendering strongly favors the same ship name, Vindristjarna, rather than a separate vessel.

The Queen and former mirror captive is Sura, also Nayan Sura. The marked span appears to repeat or expand her name, but the connecting words and full repetition cannot be resolved without reconstructing the phrase.
